title: Joe W NDE 5301
content: In 1975 I was traveling on a road that runs parallel to Highway 2, North of Fort Lewis. I was travelling at about 50 mph when a car to my right ran a stop sign, pulled in front of me and stopped. I hit my brakes hard to avoid it and skidded into the oncoming lane of traffic, hitting a very heavy truck. My last conscious thought was the date I thought I had died, October 31, 1975. The next thing that happened was I was walking in clouds in bright light. I felt that I was not in my human body but in my spirit body. I could see myself and was wearing my army uniform. I tried to convince myself that I must be dreaming but it was clear that I was in a different dimension. Every time I felt fear or anxiety, a warm nurturing feeling would overwhelm me and any fear was dispelled. I felt a great sense of love towards me. Next, I tried to make some sense of what was happening. My deceased aunt (my father’s sister) walks out of the foggy clouds to greet me. At the time of her death, many years ago, she had a stroke, which left her with walking and speech difficulties. I told her that I must be dreaming because she seemed perfectly healthy. Aunty told me that I was in-between life and death and if she was to appear in her spirit form I would not recognize her. Again, a warm and loving feeling came over me. I continued to walk in and out of the clouds and at least six deceased relatives walked in front of me. They just stood there, in front of, me and smiled. I thought this must be a dream. My grandfather told me that they appeared that way to me because I would not recognize them in their spirit form. They disappeared and within the cloud, I saw ‘swirling clouds’. I felt a presence in there and tried to clarify whom it was. I could not see a face but felt the presence of Jesus on a throne. I said ‘who are you?’ He replied ‘I am your Lord Jesus ’and I fell to my knees. Jesus said ‘Don't be afraid, I love you’. I do not have the words to express the feeling of his presence. He had unconditional love towards me and said ‘what do you think of your life so far?’ I had a strong sense I had not completed what I need to learn as a human being. Jesus said ’You may stay with me or return to being a human being’. I told Him that I wanted to stay with him but needed to go back to learn more about love and knowledge. He said, ‘If that is your decision let it be.’ I found myself regain consciousness. The first thing I heard was medical personnel saying that I was not dead. I had been trapped in the truck for over an hour. I now suffer with a traumatic brain injury and post-traumatic stress disorder as a result of the accident. I am rated 100% disabled and suffer with frequent headaches. I have found since that love can be painful and knowledge is hard to acquire in a human sense. My other NDE happened March 13, 2000. I wish to write about that event later.
